description: This Java class defines an Android Activity 'ContentPictureInPicture' that manages Picture-in-Picture mode. It sets a layout, handles receiving a ResultReceiver via intent extras, and manages lifecycle events including onStop and handling mode changes.

classes.name: ContentPictureInPicture
classes.description: An Android Activity that handles Picture-in-Picture mode, receives a ResultReceiver, and overrides lifecycle methods to respond to mode changes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and retrieves a ResultReceiver from the intent extras.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Sends a result code via the ResultReceiver when the activity stops.

methods.name: onPictureInPictureModeChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the Picture-in-Picture mode; finishes the activity if mode is exited.
